description: For a law firm, title or escrow company, lender, property manager, employer, HR or other business whose person asked you to open an MCC Solutions business account for them (notary, loan signings, apostilles, process serving, court runs and records). Opens the account with their consent; they confirm by email and the desk approves it, usually within one business day. After approval a user creates an agent key in the client portal so you can place orders. Net-30 invoicing is by owner approval. Nothing is charged.

consent.description: true when the person asked you to open the account and agreed to MCC emailing them

firm_type.description: e.g. law firm, title company, lender, property manager, employer

name: register_firm_account
title: Open a business account for a firm
